summary: Right now, the team is juggling urgent email security fixes with the push to launch the Intelligent China program and redesign the knowledge website, while aligning global marketing priorities around Asia Star and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: The most immediate issue is the Outlook account lockout: everyone must delete old email accounts and re-login with the new password across all devices, and contact JSB to confirm the backend lock is lifted. This week also requires finalizing feedback on the knowledge website redesign—Joseph, Julie, and Joker need to meet and implement changes, with decisions already made to remove the videos panel, keep the two-menu structure, and integrate the BCI index banner. On the marketing front, the June 30 strategy meeting set clear priorities: Asia Star and Intelligent China are top focus for SEO and content, with US programs on hold except possibly Berkeley; the Intelligent China webpage and email campaigns are pending launches, and conversion tracking briefs and participant profile analyses are in progress. Looking ahead, Joseph must prepare the website, SEM/SEO, GEO, and content plan for now through October, while Mara, Madi, and Xiao Rong need to provide answers and partner information for the Custom Program page rewrite by September 21–22.
